defense_contracts.raw_text: Numunu Martinez JV, Lawton, Oklahoma, is awarded a $14,637,787 firm-fixed-price contract for the Atlantic Undersea Test and Evaluation Center (AUTEC) ground water storage tanks replacement. This contract provides for the replacement of two 500,000-gallon ground potable water storage tanks and associated infrastructure. Work will be performed at the AUTEC Main Base, Andros Island, Bahamas, and is expected to be completed by January 2028. The maximum dollar value, including the base period and zero option years, is $14,637,787. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $14,637,787 will be obligated at time of award and will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was not competitively procured via SAM.gov; it is a sole-source award to an eligible 8(a) Tribal Joint Venture pursuant to 15 U.S. Code 637(a) and FAR 19.805-1(b)(2) (or 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(5)). The Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Southeast, Jacksonville, Florida (serviced by ROICC Space Coast, Cape Canaveral, Florida), is the contracting activity (N6945027C0004).
